enriched_activities.activity: Working the night shift as an aged-care support worker at the residential facility, assisting residents with personal care, checking medication charts, and writing up detailed shift notes before handover
enriched_activities.desc: Enter resident room. Turn on light. Assist resident out of bed. Walk resident to bathroom. Assist with toileting. Walk resident back to bed. Change bed linen. Check medication chart. Administer medication. Record medication given. Assist resident with dressing. Serve breakfast. Feed resident. Clear dishes. Write shift notes. Attend handover. Report to next shift.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the night shift by train and bus, checking written messages on the phone and planning the quiet routine for after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to train station. Tap on with Opal card. Wait on platform. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Open messages app. Read messages. Reply to messages. Put phone away. Alight at station. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap on. Sit down. Open notes app. Type routine. Save note. Alight at bus stop. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a light flexitarian breakfast with a cup of tea, keeping noise low and putting used dishes straight into the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open fridge. Take out milk. Take out bread. Take out cereal. Place bowl on counter. Pour cereal. Pour milk. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Wait for kettle. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Stir tea. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink tea. Stand up. Pick up bowl and mug. Open dishwasher. Place dishes in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face and brushing teeth, setting out earplugs and an eye mask then hanging a quiet-after-night-shift note on the door
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on tap. Wash face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Take out earplugs and eye mask. Place on counter. Hang note on door.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping after the night shift with the fan on low and the phone set to silent so the room stays quiet and dark
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Close door. Walk to bed. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust fan speed to low. Pick up phone. Set phone to silent. Place phone on bedside table. Close eyes. Sleep. Wake up at 15:30. Turn off fan. Get out of bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower to wake up, changing into clean casual clothes and rinsing out the previous day's work uniform
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body with soap. Rinse off. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clean clothes. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Return to bathroom. Pick up uniform. Turn on tap. Rinse uniform. Wring out uniform. Hang uniform to dry.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a pot of tea and eating a light afternoon snack while writing out the evening's to-do list in a notebook
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out teapot. Take out tea leaves. Place tea leaves in teapot. Pour hot water into teapot. Wait for tea to steep. Open fridge. Take out snack. Place snack on plate. Sit at table. Pour tea into cup. Drink tea. Eat snack. Open notebook. Pick up pen. Write to-do list. Close notebook.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting laundry, running one load in the washing machine and switching the dehumidifier on for the drying clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Open laundry basket. Sort clothes into piles. Pick up first pile. Open washing machine. Place clothes in washing machine. Add detergent. Close washing machine door. Press start button. Pick up second pile. Hang clothes on drying rack. Turn on dehumidifier. Set timer.

enriched_activities.activity: Batch-cooking a flexitarian dinner of rice, lentils and vegetables in the induction cooker and packing a portion for the next shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open fridge. Take out vegetables. Take out lentils. Take out rice. Rinse rice. Place rice in rice cooker. Add water. Turn on rice cooker. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil to pan. Add lentils. Add vegetables. Stir. Add spices. Cook. Turn off induction cooker. Open container. Place portion in container. Close container. Place in fridge.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner with a mug of tea, then wiping down the bench and checking what shared supplies need restocking
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat dinner. Drink tea. Finish meal. Stand up. Pick up plate and mug. Place in sink. Pick up cloth. Wipe bench. Open cupboard. Check supplies. Write list of supplies.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing the weekly budget on paper, counting the cash envelope for rent and bills and updating the written expense log
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Open drawer. Take out budget book. Take out cash envelope. Open envelope. Count cash. Write amount in log. Open budget book. Review expenses. Write notes. Close book. Return to drawer.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the dishwasher, hand-washing the remaining pots and setting out labelled containers so the shared kitchen stays tidy
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open dishwasher. Pick up dishes. Place dishes in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Turn on tap. Pick up pot. Scrub pot with sponge. Rinse pot. Place pot on drying rack. Pick up container. Write label. Place container on shelf.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying social work coursework at the desk with the lamp and computer on, reading assigned case notes and writing a summary
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Open case notes. Read case notes. Open textbook. Take notes. Highlight text. Write outline. Open word processor. Type summary. Save document. Turn off computer. Turn off lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Replying with text-only messages to housemates, checking the shared calendar and writing reminders for the next shift and class
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type reply. Send message. Open calendar app. Check events. Open notes app. Type reminders. Save reminders. Put phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene routine, brushing teeth and washing up before bed while keeping the corridor quiet
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face. Dry face. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with a glance at the photo of the family dog, doing a short breathing exercise, then turning off the light and sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Pick up photo frame. Look at photo. Place photo frame down. Sit on bed. Close eyes. Take deep breath. Exhale. Repeat breathing. Lie down. Pull blanket. Turn off light. Close eyes. Sleep.
